neighbours.label: ' single' in 'from/on a single <noun>' (everything traced to one source); broad weak firing on a/an/in opening a noun phrase
fire: The whole outage was traced back to a single faulty router in the basement.
Every painting in the hall came from a single private collection.
The rumor started with a single anonymous post on the forum.
All forty seedlings were grown from a single parent plant.
The entire archive now fits on a single memory card.
The infection spread from a single patient to the whole ward.
The team's budget depends on a single donor in Geneva.
The novel is told from a single point of view throughout.
quiet: The whole outage was traced back to faulty routers in the basement.
Every painting in the hall came from private collections abroad.
The rumor started with several anonymous posts on the forum.
All forty seedlings were grown from two parent plants.
